name: list_posts
title: List posts
description: Lists the newest posts of the blog, newest first: the published ones and the drafts of the key's user.

limit.description: How many of the newest posts to list.

name: search_posts
title: Search posts
description: Lists the posts whose title or content contains the query, case-insensitive, newest first.

query.description: The text to look for; it must contain a non-whitespace character.

limit.description: How many of the newest matches to list.

name: read_post
title: Read a post
description: Reads one post or page by its slug, with its Markdown content.

slug.description: The slug of the post or page, as list_posts and search_posts give it.

name: read_media_source
title: Read the source of an image
description: Reads the editable source of an image in a post, such as the draw.io diagram XML of a diagram, by the image's slug.

slug.description: The slug of the image: the end of its URL /public/api/v1/media/{slug} in a post.

name: create_post
title: Create a draft post
description: Writes a new post. It is always a draft; the user publishes it in the editor. The slug has only English letters, digits and '-'.

hashTags.description: The hash tags separated by commas, without #.

name: update_post
title: Update a draft post
description: Changes a draft the key's user wrote. Only the arguments that are given change. A published post, a page and someone else's post are refused.

slug.description: The current slug of the draft.

content.description: The new Markdown of the whole post.

hashTags.description: The new hash tags; an empty text removes them.
